name: Haus Arnold Schranz
beschreibung: The holiday apartment Haus Arnold Schranz is located in St. Anton am Arlberg in Tirol. The accommodation is designed for guests who visit the region for winter sports or summer activities. The apartment has a living area, a kitchen, and a bathroom. It accommodates several people and is suitable for families or small groups. The location allows easy access to the ski lifts and hiking trails of the Arlberg area. Shopping options and dining establishments are located in the surrounding area. The apartment is bookable year-round and serves as a starting point for activities in the mountains.
